extension_name.description: The display name for the extension.

extension_description.message: Hide Reels, Stories, Explore, suggested posts and accounts, and sponsored posts on Instagram Web.
extension_description.description: Description of what the extension does.

popup_subtitle.message: Choose which Instagram distractions to hide.

toggle_hide_reels_desc.message: Removes Reels navigation and Reel posts from Home.

toggle_keep_reels_collapsed_title.description: Title for the compact Reel row sub-option.

toggle_keep_reels_collapsed_desc.message: Shows the author and a Show anyway button without loading the video.
toggle_keep_reels_collapsed_desc.description: Description for the compact Reel row sub-option.

hidden_reel_placeholder.description: Label displayed in place of a hidden Home Reel.

hidden_reel_from.description: Label for a collapsed Reel with its author.

hidden_post_placeholder.description: Label for a compact hidden Home post.

show_reel_anyway.description: Button that reveals one collapsed Reel.

toggle_hide_search_reels_title.description: Title for hiding Reel cards in Search.

toggle_hide_search_reels_desc.message: Removes Reel cards in Search and Explore.
toggle_hide_search_reels_desc.description: Description for hiding Reel cards in Search.

toggle_hide_explore_desc.message: Removes the magnifying glass shortcut to Explore.

toggle_hide_suggested_posts_title.description: Title for hide suggested posts toggle.

toggle_hide_suggested_posts_desc.message: Hides recommended feed posts and switches Home to Following when available.
toggle_hide_suggested_posts_desc.description: Description for hide suggested posts toggle.

toggle_hide_sponsored_posts_title.description: Title for hide sponsored posts toggle.

toggle_hide_sponsored_posts_desc.message: Removes posts labelled Sponsored from the Home feed.
toggle_hide_sponsored_posts_desc.description: Description for hide sponsored posts toggle.

toggle_hide_suggested_users_title.description: Title for hide suggested users toggle.

toggle_hide_suggested_users_desc.description: Description for hide suggested users toggle.

toggle_hide_stories_desc.message: Removes the story carousel at the top of the feed.

status_load_error.message: Couldn't reach the extension. Try again.

hint_autosave.message: Changes save instantly and apply to open instagram.com tabs.

instructions_step1.message: Enable No Reel For Instagram in Safari: on Mac, open Safari ▸ Settings ▸ Extensions; on iPhone/iPad, go to Settings ▸ Safari ▸ Extensions.

instructions_step2.message: Open instagram.com and sign in. Reload any tabs you already have open.

instructions_step3.message: Use this popup to turn features on or off whenever you need a calmer feed.

instructions_note.message: Tip: allow Safari to run the extension in Private Browsing if you use it there.
